topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Well, now, isn’t that a fine turn of the earth? My little one’s got the same teacher as I had back when the world seemed younger. Old Master Halbert, he knows his seeds and soils, and I’ve no doubt he’ll teach my girl the ways of the world, just as he taught me. The ways of the plow and the hoe, and when it’s the right time to till, to sow, and to reap. His lessons, they stick in the mind just like a good harvest sticks in the memory. I can see my girl learning the value of honest work, learning to respect the land and the saints. It feels like the old times are coming 'round again, and that’s a good thing, a very good thing indeed.
